hooks.name: Sync English Documentation
hooks.description: When German documentation files (README.de.md, HOWTO.de.md, .kiro/README.md) are saved, prompt to update the corresponding English version.

action.prompt:
A German documentation file was just saved. Please update the corresponding English version to match:

- README.de.md → README.md
- HOWTO.de.md → HOWTO.md  
- .kiro/README.md → .kiro/README.en.md

Read the saved German file and update the English counterpart with a proper translation. Preserve formatting, code blocks, and links. Do not translate technical terms, tool names, or code.
